summary: Compaction aligned to pi (compaction.ts/utils.ts). Cut points are user or completed assistant records (never tool results), so one long turn can be split; the turn prefix gets its own summary request and pi's '**Turn Context (split turn):**' merge. Opaque provider state in the summarized prefix is dropped instead of vetoing the cut. Summary input is pi's role-labelled text ([User]/[Assistant]/[Assistant tool calls]/[Tool result]) inside <conversation>, with <previous-summary> for iterative updates, tool results cut to 2000 chars, no metadata/signatures/reasoning. Output caps are floor(0.8*reserve) for history and floor(0.5*reserve) for the prefix (each clamped to the model output reservation), sent one after the other; every summary request is checked against the context window before any send, and all ledger reservations happen up front. Summaries are free text (no JSON/file-list echo); the checkpoint's read/modified files are appended as <read-files>/<modified-files> when the summary is projected. New config [compaction] {enabled=true, reserve_tokens=16384, keep_recent_tokens=20000} (CompactionSettings, Agent::set_compaction_settings, loaded by the CLI run path). Trigger: latest real usage (total, or input+output; usage before the latest checkpoint is ignored) plus an estimate of later records > window - reserve; the hard over-budget compaction remains. A provider ContextOverflow compacts once (forced) and retries once; a second overflow returns context_overflow. Tool-call assistant records now carry their usage so long tool loops have a real-usage anchor.

notes: Outside owned paths (test fixtures that encoded the old JSON summary contract; no product code): tests/stage1_semantic_compaction.rs (helpers read the text request and return free-text summaries; removed the 'json' and 'file_loss' invalid-summary cases that no longer apply; the opaque-state-veto test became the Anthropic-signed compaction validator; added the four row validators, a per-request status hook on the HTTP fixture and a budget-parameterized agent helper), tests/stage1_context_checkpoint.rs (assistant cut points: expectations 6->7, and a call missing/unknown result now yields a cut before the call, source_end 2, instead of an error), tests/resume_compact_owner.rs, tests/stage1_input_host.rs, tests/stage1_branch_owner.rs (scripted summary replies no longer parse the request as JSON). Design choices beyond pi's literal text, needed for zenpi's small-window fixtures and unknown models: the configured reserve applies only while 2*reserve < window, otherwise the model output reservation is the reserve; keep_recent_tokens is clamped to half the input capacity; summary output caps are clamped to the model output reservation. A threshold-only trigger that finds no safe cut (or is vetoed by unknown outcomes) sends the still-fitting context unchanged; over-budget/overflow compaction still fails explicitly. enabled=false disables the threshold trigger and overflow retry, while the pre-existing hard over-budget compaction and manual /compact remain. Manual /compact keeps its existing 'compact only when triggered' behaviour. The split-turn summary record is projected with the user role (pi compactionSummary) so wires still open with a user message; whole-turn cuts keep the system role. Legacy prepare_context/restore_checkpoint are left for ZE-235.
